claims.text: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to hallucination.
LLM hallucinations involve generating plausible yet nonfactual content.
LLM hallucinations raise significant concerns over the reliability of LLMs in real-world information retrieval (IR) systems.
LLM hallucinations have attracted intensive research to detect and mitigate such hallucinations.
LLM hallucinations present distinct challenges that diverge from prior task-specific models.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey and Taxonomy Construction
methodologies.description: The paper provides an innovative taxonomy of LLM hallucinations and a comprehensive overview of detection methods, benchmarks, and mitigation strategies.

limitations.text: Retrieval-augmented LLMs face limitations in combating hallucinations.

future_work.text: Understanding of knowledge boundaries in LLM hallucinations.
